items.difficulty_reason: For f : X -> Y flat locally of finite presentation and any g : Y' -> Y, a Y-perfect complex K on X pulls back to a Y'-perfect complex L(g')^* K on X' = Y' x_Y X — stability of the relative perfect cone under base change. The retained proof is written: the chapter's affine-locality dictionary (lemma affine-locally-rel-perfect) reduces both spaces to affine schemes in one etale sweep; the affine case is the schemes theorem Derived Categories of Schemes, lemma base-change-relatively-perfect (perfection descends/ascends along flat finitely presented base change of the structure map), quoted by name. Retained author proof at lines 12412-12418.
